question: Who was sworn in as the 21st President of South Korea?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Lee Jae-myung**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Lee Jae-myung elected as South Korea’s President.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Lee Jae-myung**, from the **Liberal Democratic Party**, is the **21st President of South Korea**.

 
 
• 
 
Won against **Kim Moon-soo** of the **People Power Party**.

 
 
• 
 
**Snap poll** followed the **ouster of former president Yoon Suk-yeol** for attempting **martial law**.

 
 
• 
 
Lee vows to **prevent military coups**, calling Yoon’s attempt a **military coup**.

 
 
• 
 
Promises a **pro-market**, **deregulated**, and **innovation-driven government**.

 
 
• 
 
Will pursue **dialogue with North Korea** and maintain ties with the **U.S.**.
